questions.prompt: In 1989–90 John Stockton set the NBA record for assists per game in a season. What was it?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: As of 2019, Stockton also held the record for assists-per-game average over one season (14.5 in 1990).

funFacts.text: Stockton led the league in assists for nine consecutive seasons, an extraordinary run of consistency.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: leading the NBA in assists per game, which he would do for nine consecutive seasons

funFacts.text: He produced at least 1,000 assists in a single season on seven separate occasions.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Stockton accomplished this feat seven times

funFacts.text: Stockton ended his playing career with 15,806 assists, far ahead of other point guards.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 1974–75 Warriors win?
questions.note: 48 wins, before the Warriors took the title.

funFacts.text: The Bullets entered the Finals with far more regular-season wins than Golden State.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Golden State Warriors (48–34) played against the Eastern Conference champion Washington Bullets (60–22)

funFacts.text: The championship was Golden State's first since 1956, when the franchise played in Philadelphia.

source.quote: win their first championship since 1956, when the team was still based in Philadelphia

funFacts.text: Golden State traded future Hall of Famer Nate Thurmond to Chicago for young center Clifford Ray before the season.

source.quote: they traded future Hall of Famer Nate Thurmond to the Chicago Bulls for young center Clifford Ray

questions.prompt: What percentage of his three-pointers did Khris Middleton make in the 2019 playoffs?
questions.note: 43.5%, a sharp shooting run despite Milwaukee's conference finals loss.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.derivation: Converted 0.435 three-point field-goal proportion in the playoff row to 43.5%.

funFacts.text: Middleton averaged 16.9 points and 6.3 rebounds during Milwaukee's playoff run.
The Bucks swept Detroit before eliminating Boston in five games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Bucks defeated the Detroit Pistons in the First Round by a four-game sweep

questions.prompt: How many points did Brook Lopez score in Milwaukee's Eastern finals Game 1 against Toronto?
questions.context: Milwaukee Bucks vs Toronto Raptors · Eastern finals opener
questions.note: 29 points to help Milwaukee take the series opener.

funFacts.text: Lopez signed with Milwaukee in free agency after spending the preceding season with the Lakers.
